name: FPDI - PDF printing with template
description: Print any View onto an existing PDF template using the FPDI/TCPDF libraries.
project_description: FPDI Print generates a PDF from a Drupal View, optionally overlaying the view's field data onto an existing PDF template ("stamping"). It ships a Views area handler that renders a download link; following the link streams a PDF built by the TCPDF+FPDI stack. A YAML "position" configuration places text, HTML, images and even whole merged PDF pages at x/y coordinates on the template; leaving it empty prints the rendered view HTML instead. It can import PDF 1.4 form templates and fill AcroForm fields via FPDM. Global settings control page format, orientation, a print CSS file and footer height. A developer service (fpdi_print.print_builder) and a hook_fpdi_print_views_alter let code drive PDF generation directly.
